# Station Security
Security aboard the station is contracted from the United Nations, with the security force being contracted UN Peacekeepers led by a member of IRIS, the armed military branch of the UN.
As members of the Security team, you are in charge of the protection of the station from everyday hazards such as fauna that threaten salvagers or the effects of research on exotic metamaterials, and just generally keeping the peace. You are also in charge of maintaining control of lethal and non-lethal weaponry. You are at the service of the station and the System Consortium as a whole, and are held to a high standard of patience, kindness, and comportment.
You will be required to learn and understand several documents in your time with the UN and SysCon:
